description: Exeter lists Microsoft Copilot as a university-licensed tool and routes licence requests through its IT Service Desk.
howToObtain: Submit an AI tool licence request through the IT Service Desk.
costToUser: Not specified by the cited source.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: When using University-licensed tools with your Exeter account (such as Microsoft Copilot), your data is handled in line with contractual and privacy agreements. To request an AI tool license, submit a request via the IT Service Desk.
